name: grumpy
_note: A COMPATIBILITY demo: one agent node that runs a near-verbatim port of gh-aw's own grumpy-reviewer.md (github/gh-aw .github/workflows/grumpy-reviewer.md). Its purpose is to prove a simple, real gh-aw workflow runs on our substrate with only the adaptations every adopter makes (engine block -> our LLM gateway; cli-proxy off; sudo sandbox; drop the otlp observability import) plus ONE content change: Step 2 reads the PR via the forge-agnostic `pull_request_read` tool instead of the `gh` CLI, whose --json/diff calls become GitHub-specific GraphQL our REST-first gh2gl proxy doesn't serve. Everything else — the review flow, the `create-pull-request-review-comment` / `submit-pull-request-review` safe-outputs — is reused unchanged; gh2gl translates those to GitLab MR discussions/approvals. UNLIKE toy/demo, this node has NO custom `evidence` safe-output and NO checks: grumpy's deliverable IS the review comments it posts to the forge (a STANDARD gh-aw safe-output), so success is observed as a clean run + comments landing on the MR, not settled from an evidence JSON. It is therefore a terminal, check-less agent node. Known no-op preserved faithfully: grumpy's body reads/writes /tmp/gh-aw/cache-memory/, but neither grumpy nor anything in its import closure declares `tools: cache-memory:` (and it is not implicit), so that memory is ephemeral scratch upstream too. Trigger `/grumpy` on an MR comment.
